description: This C# source file defines the ContentLinkTagHelper class, a Razor TagHelper for generating links to various content item pages (admin, display, edit, remove, create) within OrchardCore CMS. It manages route values and preview URLs for content items.

classes.name: ContentLinkTagHelper
classes.description: A Razor TagHelper for generating links to content item pages (admin, display, edit, remove, create) in OrchardCore.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the tag helper to generate appropriate href attributes based on content item properties and route values.

methods.name: ApplyRouteValues
methods.description: Static helper method to add route parameters from HTML attributes to the route dictionary.
